text:
sarah_pm: Quick sync — how should we prioritize the latency vs cost asks for the Chat inference work this sprint? Enterprise customer wants p95 down from ~420ms -> ~250ms on ~2k-token responses, plus ~15% inference cost reduction. Do we run RICE or just impact/effort? Need gating and launch criteria.

devon_eng: I'd vote RICE + concrete SLA gates. FWIW rough dev estimate: caching + latency guards ~2-3w (1-2 engs), model-variant + quantize ~3-4w. Batching changes are low effort but risk throughput regressions.

miguel_ml: Agree on RICE, but first we need representative traces. Small thing: latency depends heavily on seq length distribution and tokenization. Can we get 5–10k real requests? Without that numbers will be guesses.

anya_sre: If we tweak batching we must update rate limits and circuit breakers. Also bring the chaos env into the loop: if p95 improves but p99 or error rate regresses we fail gate. Add canary steps.

leo_se: Customer language: "interactive feel" — they prioritized tail latency over raw cost. They said they can tolerate up to ~10% cost increase if p95 is <300ms. So impact is likely high for retention.

sarah_pm: Proposal: use RICE with a short internal spreadsheet. Example seeds: Reach=5 (enterprises), Impact=8, Confidence=6. Effort as eng-weeks. Also propose launch gates: p95 <= 300ms on customer trace, error rate <= baseline + 1%, cost/unit <= baseline * 1.05. Thoughts?

devon_eng: Quick calc: R5 * I8 * C6 = 240. If Effort=8 eng-weeks -> RICE ~30. If Effort=3 eng-weeks (caching-only) -> RICE = 80. So sequencing matters: do caching + KV prefix first (small effort, big latency wins) then model quantization as follow-up.

miguel_ml: Sequence sounds right. Data plan: need a 10k-sample export of tokens, seq lengths, and per-request latency from their region. If infra can stage that by EOW we can run profiling and simulate impact.

product-ops-bot: Data export ticket created: #1234, requested by @sarah_pm — ETA 48h.

anya_sre: Canary policy suggestion: 1% traffic for 6h -> 10% for 12h -> 100%. Rollback if p95 worsens by >10% or error rate increases by >0.5pp. Add tracing and SLO dashboards before canary.

sarah_pm: Great. Action items: (1) @miguel_ml confirm data availability by EOD, (2) @devon_eng draft minimal spec for caching + latency guard, (3) I will assemble 1-pager with RICE numbers and gate checklist for triage. If data is green we'll prioritize caching in sprint 37.

leo_se: :thumbsup:

devon_eng: I'll drop a spec in #eng-runtime today, incl diagrams and fallback behavior.

sarah_pm: Thanks — we'll review this in the 2pm triage.
